name: Salesflare
description:
Salesflare connects Claude to your Salesflare CRM, so you can find, summarize, and update sales data without switching tools.

Use it to look up accounts, contacts, opportunities, tasks, notes, meetings, and customer interactions; summarize relationship history; identify deals that need follow-up; create or update CRM records; and prepare better outreach based on real CRM context.

Salesflare is a simple yet powerful CRM for small and medium-sized B2B businesses. It helps teams track leads automatically, follow up consistently, manage visual sales pipelines, collaborate on customer relationships, and reduce manual CRM admin. The connector brings that CRM context into Claude so sales teams can work faster while staying grounded in their actual Salesflare data.

This connector can read and write CRM data according to the permissions of the connected Salesflare user.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Salesflare to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Salesflare to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.salesflare.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Salesflare MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Salesflare lists 16 MCP tools, including create_account, create_contact, create_opportunity, create_task, get_account_feed, list_accounts, list_contacts, list_opportunities, list_pipelines, list_tags, list_tasks, and list_users.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Salesflare?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Salesflare in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Salesflare requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Salesflare is developed by Salesflare. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
